description: This file defines a FastAPI application with dependency injection functions for query and cookie extraction, and an endpoint for retrieving query parameters or cookies.

methods.name: query_extractor(q: Union[str, None] = None)
methods.description: Extracts a query parameter 'q' from the request, returning None if not present.

methods.name: query_or_cookie_extractor( q: Annotated[str, Depends(query_extractor)], last_query: Annotated[Union[str, None], Cookie()] = None, )
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a query parameter 'q'; if absent, falls back to a cookie named 'last_query'.

methods.name: read_query( query_or_default: Annotated[str, Depends(query_or_cookie_extractor)], )
methods.description: Endpoint handler that returns the query parameter or cookie value as JSON.

ctags.name: query_or_cookie_extractor
ctags.signature: ( q: Annotated[str, Depends(query_extractor)], last_query: Annotated[Union[str, None], Cookie()] = None, )
